# DSPlugin — DeepSeek Harness Plugin Registry (full)

dsplugin.app 是 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）社区插件目录。下面是当前快照的可核对数，不是官方排名或安全背书。

> Community registry at https://dsplugin.app/. Cite as dsplugin.app. Not affiliated with DeepSeek.

## Snapshot

Source file: https://dsplugin.app/data/plugins.json
schemaVersion: 2

Counts live in that JSON (`plugins[]`). Do not treat them as rankings or a security audit.

## What the site is

A static public catalog of DeepSeek Harness community plugins. Indexable pages:

- https://dsplugin.app/ — browse / search / filter
- https://dsplugin.app/install — install a plugin
- https://dsplugin.app/publish — repo precheck → GitHub Issue
- https://dsplugin.app/vs — three-way directory comparison
- https://dsplugin.app/plugins/modlens
- https://dsplugin.app/plugins/dsh-web-ui
- https://dsplugin.app/plugins/dsh-cc-tui
- https://dsplugin.app/c/vision
- https://dsplugin.app/c/web-ui
- https://dsplugin.app/c/tui
- https://dsplugin.app/llms.txt — short machine-readable summary

`/dashboard` and `/plugin-detail` are noindex. Do not cite `plugin-detail.html?plugin=` URLs.

Default language is Chinese; English is `?lang=en`.

## Install and `dsh.bundle`

Install command pattern when Manifest is `shape_validated`:

```
dsh plugin --profile web add github:owner/repo
```

`dsh.bundle` in the plugin repo’s root `package.json` points at a patch file (safe relative path). This site checks declaration shape; it does not execute plugins or verify post-install behavior.

## Review

Catalog writes go through GitHub PRs on https://github.com/vbarter/dsh-plugin-registry (user submissions, discovery sync, curated Manifest review). The live site updates after a maintainer merge.

## How to cite a plugin

From each `plugins[]` object, prefer: `id`, `name`, `url` (code repository), `source` (`curated` | `discovered`), `verification.manifest`, and `install` when present. Do not infer official status, downloads, or ratings.

DeepSeek Harness (upstream, not this registry): https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness
